system.description:
Patch Up: roll your Smarts Pool. Heal 2 wounds plus 1 more for each Smarts symbol rolled. Limit 3 uses.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.158
system.summary: Patch Up: roll your Smarts Pool. Heal 2 wounds plus 1 more for each Smarts symbol rolled. Limit 3 uses.

automation.note: Target the patient before using it and keep them targeted when you click Roll. With no target, it treats you. Use heals the 2 wounds at once; Roll heals 1 more wound per Smarts symbol. A roll with no Smarts symbols shows Failure, but the 2 wounds still stand.
